questions.question: What is the greatest number of distinct people to stand as candidates in a single election?

queries.typeql: match $e isa election; $p isa person; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); reduce $x = count groupby $e, $p; reduce $n = count groupby $e; reduce $max = max($n);
queries.sql: SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT b.election_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.person_id) AS cnt FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id GROUP BY b.election_id) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:Election) WITH e, count(DISTINCT p) AS cnt RETURN max(cnt)

questions.question: How many people were elected in more than one ballot?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p), has elected true; reduce $n = count groupby $p; match $n > 1; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT person_id FROM candidacy WHERE elected = true GROUP BY person_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(c:Candidacy) WHERE c.elected = true WITH p, count(c) AS wins WHERE wins > 1 RETURN count(p)

questions.question: How many parties never had a candidate elected?

queries.typeql: match $pa isa party; not { $_ isa candidacy, links (party: $pa), has elected true; }; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM party p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidacy c WHERE c.party_id = p.party_id AND c.elected = true);
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Party) WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(p) WHERE c.elected = true } RETURN count(p)

questions.question: What is the largest number of candidates standing in a single ballot?

queries.typeql: match $b isa ballot; $c isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b); reduce $n = count($c) groupby $b; reduce $max = max($n);
queries.sql: SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT ballot_paper_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM candidacy GROUP BY ballot_paper_id) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b:Ballot) WITH b, count(c) AS cnt RETURN max(cnt)

questions.question: Which party won the most seats in the 2024 general election?

queries.typeql: match $e isa election, has election_id "parl.2024-07-04"; $pa isa party, has party_name $name; $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa, ballot: $b), has elected true; at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); reduce $n = count($c) groupby $pa, $name; sort $n desc; limit 1; select $name;
queries.sql: SELECT p.party_name FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN party p ON c.party_id = p.party_id WHERE c.elected = true AND b.election_id = 'parl.2024-07-04' GROUP BY p.party_id, p.party_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(b:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(:Election {election_id: 'parl.2024-07-04'}), (c)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(p:Party) WHERE c.elected = true WITH p, count(c) AS n RETURN p.party_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many people have stood as candidates in more than one distinct election?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); reduce $x = count groupby $p, $e; reduce $n = count groupby $p; match $n > 1; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.person_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id GROUP BY c.person_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.election_id) > 1) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:Election) WITH p, count(DISTINCT e) AS elections WHERE elections > 1 RETURN count(p)

questions.question: What is the greatest number of distinct elections that any single post has been contested in?

queries.typeql: match $po isa post; for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); reduce $x = count groupby $po, $e; reduce $n = count groupby $po; reduce $max = max($n);
queries.sql: SELECT MAX(n) FROM (SELECT b.post_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.election_id) AS n FROM ballot b GROUP BY b.post_id) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (po:Post)<-[:FOR_POST]-(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:Election) WITH po, count(DISTINCT e) AS n RETURN max(n)

questions.question: Which organisation, other than the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, has returned the most elected representatives?

queries.typeql: match $o isa organisation, has organisation_name $name; $name != "House of Commons of the United Kingdom"; $c isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b), has elected true; elects_to (ballot: $b, organisation: $o); reduce $n = count($c) groupby $o, $name; sort $n desc; limit 1; select $name;
queries.sql: SELECT b.organisation_name FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE c.elected = true AND b.organisation_name IS NOT NULL AND b.organisation_name <> 'House of Commons of the United Kingdom' GROUP BY b.organisation_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:ELECTS_TO]->(o:Organisation) WHERE c.elected = true AND o.organisation_name <> 'House of Commons of the United Kingdom' WITH o, count(c) AS n RETURN o.organisation_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many people have been elected to more than one distinct organisation?

queries.typeql: match $p isa person; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b), has elected true; elects_to (ballot: $b, organisation: $o); reduce $x = count groupby $p, $o; reduce $n = count groupby $p; match $n > 1; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.person_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id WHERE c.elected = true AND b.organisation_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.person_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.organisation_name) > 1) t;
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:ELECTS_TO]->(o:Organisation) WHERE c.elected = true WITH p, count(DISTINCT o) AS orgs WHERE orgs > 1 RETURN count(p)

questions.question: What's the ID of the election that had the most distinct parties standing?

queries.typeql: match $e isa election, has election_id $eid; $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa, ballot: $b); at_election (ballot: $b, election: $e); reduce $x = count groupby $eid, $pa; reduce $n = count groupby $eid; sort $n desc; limit 1; select $eid;
queries.sql: SELECT b.election_id FROM candidacy c JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id GROUP BY b.election_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.party_id) DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:AT_ELECTION]->(e:Election), (c)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(pa:Party) WITH e, count(DISTINCT pa) AS n RETURN e.election_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many distinct people have stood for election in Scotland?

queries.typeql: match $po isa post, has nuts1 "Scotland"; $p isa person; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, ballot: $b); for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); reduce $x = count groupby $p; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ca.person_id) FROM candidacy ca JOIN ballot b ON ca.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN post po ON b.post_id = po.post_id WHERE po.nuts1 = 'Scotland';

questions.question: Which party has won the most seats in Scotland?

queries.typeql: match $po isa post, has nuts1 "Scotland"; $pa isa party, has party_name $name; $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa, ballot: $b), has elected true; for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); reduce $n = count($c) groupby $pa, $name; sort $n desc; limit 1; select $name;
queries.sql: SELECT p.party_name FROM candidacy ca JOIN ballot b ON ca.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN post po ON b.post_id = po.post_id JOIN party p ON ca.party_id = p.party_id WHERE ca.elected = true AND po.nuts1 = 'Scotland' GROUP BY p.party_id, p.party_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (c:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:FOR_POST]->(po:Post {nuts1: 'Scotland'}), (c)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(p:Party) WHERE c.elected = true WITH p, count(c) AS n RETURN p.party_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: In which region have the most candidacies been contested?

queries.typeql: match $po isa post, has nuts1 $region; $c isa candidacy, links (ballot: $b); for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); reduce $n = count($c) groupby $region; sort $n desc; limit 1; select $region;
queries.sql: SELECT po.nuts1 FROM candidacy ca JOIN ballot b ON ca.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN post po ON b.post_id = po.post_id WHERE po.nuts1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY po.nuts1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
queries.cypher: MATCH (:Candidacy)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:FOR_POST]->(po:Post) WHERE po.nuts1 IS NOT NULL WITH po.nuts1 AS region, count(*) AS n RETURN region ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many distinct parties have fielded a candidate in Wales?

queries.typeql: match $po isa post, has nuts1 "Wales"; $pa isa party; $c isa candidacy, links (party: $pa, ballot: $b); for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); reduce $x = count groupby $pa; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ca.party_id) FROM candidacy ca JOIN ballot b ON ca.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN post po ON b.post_id = po.post_id WHERE po.nuts1 = 'Wales';

questions.question: How many people have stood for the 'Scottish National Party (SNP)' in a Scottish constituency?

queries.typeql: match $pa isa party, has party_name "Scottish National Party (SNP)"; $po isa post, has nuts1 "Scotland"; $c isa candidacy, links (candidate: $p, party: $pa, ballot: $b); for_post (ballot: $b, post: $po); reduce $x = count groupby $p; reduce $count = count;
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.person_id) FROM candidacy c JOIN party p ON c.party_id = p.party_id JOIN ballot b ON c.ballot_paper_id = b.ballot_paper_id JOIN post po ON b.post_id = po.post_id WHERE p.party_name = 'Scottish National Party (SNP)' AND po.nuts1 = 'Scotland';
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:STOOD]->(c:Candidacy)-[:FOR_PARTY]->(:Party {party_name: 'Scottish National Party (SNP)'}), (c)-[:IN_BALLOT]->(:Ballot)-[:FOR_POST]->(po:Post {nuts1: 'Scotland'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT p)
